// diagnostic

L0152

`{value}` ends in state `{one}` on one path and `{other}` on another.

What

`{value}` ends in state `{one}` on one path and `{other}` on another.

Why

Typestate (D-STATE1, D-FACT-FLOW1): after two paths meet, a state holds only when both paths agree — here they do not, so the value is untracked from this point and later state checks on it stay silent.

Fix

Bring both paths to the same state before they meet, or do the work that needs the state inside the path that reaches it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0152: tests/ui/typestate_state_diverges.stderr.
